meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后，升级 NanoClaw 时它会先提取你对代码的所有自定义改动（配置、源码等），写成一份可重放的迁移指南；然后在干净的上游版本上按指南重新应用这些改动，避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你想把 fork 升级到上游新版本时使用；如果迁移指南已存在，也会先询问是直接升级还是更新指南。它会在操作前检查工作区是否干净，并创建回滚点。

say.text: 帮我把这个 fork 升级到最新上游，保留我的自定义。
先提取我的自定义改动，生成迁移指南。
我有迁移指南了，直接开始升级。
say.note: 跳到升级阶段，在干净副本上重放。

howto.what_en: When upgrading NanoClaw, this skill extracts all your customizations from the fork into a replayable migration guide, then reapplies them on a clean upstream checkout, avoiding merge conflicts. It never touches data directories.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to upgrade your fork upstream. If a guide already exists, it offers to skip straight to upgrade. It checks for a clean working tree and creates a rollback point.

say_en.text: Upgrade this fork to the latest upstream while keeping my customizations.
Extract my customizations and generate a migration guide.
say_en.note: Analyzes code and writes the guide.

say_en.text: I already have a guide; start the upgrade directly.
say_en.note: Skips to upgrade and replays on a clean checkout.
